_doc: Fox Client cosmetics manifest. CAPES: drop a 2:1 landscape PNG (64x32 or an HD multiple) into assets/kitsune/textures/cape/<id>.png and register under 'capes'. TRAILS (v1.6): register under 'trails' with a 'particle' key (flame|heart|crit|soul|happy|portal|end_rod|smoke|snowflake|enchant). OWNERS: list cape AND/OR trail ids under 'owners' keyed by the player's Minecraft UUID (dashes optional). The '*' key grants to every player.
